 Measurement and Control Electronics
Measurement and Control Electronics
... the Heart of Every Testing Machine!
testControl II measurement and control technology is well and truly "Made by ZwickRoell". Development and production take place entirely in Ulm, allowing optimum matching of all components and enabling ZwickRoell to offer outstanding support. During development ZwickRoell can draw on experience gained from over 12,000 measurement and control electronics installations.
Our sophisticated electronics combine reliability with optimum ease of use
Measurement and control electronics are key to the efficiency of the testing system. Powerful solutions available from the ZwickRoell Group include Control Cube for multiaxial applications and modernizations and testControl II for complex testing situations, both static and dynamic.
